name: Mixedbread mxbai-embed-large-v1
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: Encoder: kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. Identical architecture to bge-large-en-v1.5, gte-large, and e5-large-v2: BERT-large, hidden 1024, 24 layers, 16 heads, intermediate 4096, vocab 30522, 512 max_position_embeddings. The Mixedbread model is distinguished by its training data and fine-tuning, not by architecture. Apache-2.0. GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
